paper_title: TL;DR Too Long, Do Re-weighting for Effcient LLM Reasoning Compression
caption: Comparison of accuracy and generation length between Vanilla CoT and our method on four benchmark datasets (GSM8K, MATH500, AIME, AMC) using DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen models. consistently reduces generation length while maintaining or improving accuracy across both 7B and 14B model scales.
model_annotation: This bar chart compares the generation length in words between "Vanilla CoT" and "TLDR (Ours)" across four different datasets: GSM8K, MATH500, AIME, and AMC, using the DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B model. The horizontal axis lists the four datasets, while the vertical axis represents the generation length in words, ranging from 0 to 8000 with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 1000. The chart features two types of bars for each dataset, with "Vanilla CoT" represented by light red bars and "TLDR (Ours)" by dark red bars. The generation lengths for "Vanilla CoT" are approximately 679, 2951, 6701, and 4584 words for GSM8K, MATH500, AIME, and AMC, respectively, while the corresponding values for "TLDR (Ours)" are lower, at around 237, 2036, 6420, and 3846 words, representing percentage decreases of -65%, -31%, -4%, and -16%, respectively. The bars are grouped by dataset, with the two methods compared side by side for each dataset, and no specific sorting order is observed among the datasets themselves.
